name: FFS_SCHED_SAVINGS_STATS
description: Contains routing savings statistics collected on the routing bucket level and for particular days.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the resource (bucket). It is the foreign key to the table FFS_RESOURCE.

columns.name: ROUTE_DATE
columns.description: Date the statistics is collected for.

columns.name: ROUTING_RUNS
columns.description: Number of times the scheduling was run on this bucket/date.

columns.name: WORK_TIME_INCREASE
columns.description: Total work time increase in the comparison with baseline settings.

columns.name: TRAVEL_TIME_REDUCTION
columns.description: Total travel time reduction in the comparison with baseline settings.

columns.name: OVER_TIME_REDUCTION
columns.description: Total overtime reduction in the comparison with baseline settings.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
